title: 蒸汽機車連桿與配氣機構
summary: 在無動力機構示意追蹤位置、相位及連接負荷，區分幾何關係與實際蒸汽動力。
summaryEn: Trace position, phase and joint load in an unpowered schematic, separating kinematics from real steam power.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 滑塊曲柄位置：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Slider-crank position: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 滑塊曲柄位置 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Slider-crank position and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為蒸汽機車連桿、曲柄與配氣示意。幾何關係連接曲柄轉角與滑塊位置；有限連桿長使往復運動非純正弦。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows steam-locomotive rods, cranks and valve-gear diagrams. Geometry links crank angle and slider position; finite rod length makes reciprocation nonsinusoidal.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：x=r cos(theta)+sqrt(l²-r² sin²(theta))；r=.1 m、l=.4 m、theta=pi/3；計算結果=0.44051248 m。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: x=r cos(theta)+sqrt(l²-r² sin²(theta)); r=.1 m, l=.4 m, theta=pi/3; result=0.44051248 m.
steps.failure: 配氣相位與連桿幾何不能混為一談；分別畫幾何位置與閥開度。

steps.check: 指定原點下x約.440512 m；需先說清位置原點而非直接叫做行程。 將此判讀連回蒸汽機車連桿、曲柄與配氣示意的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: With the stated origin x is about .440512 m; define the origin rather than calling it stroke. Relate this interpretation to steam-locomotive rods, cranks and valve-gear diagrams and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
